이름에서 알 수 있듯 이북식 만두와 녹두전을 맛볼 수 있는 곳이다. 직접 빚은 만두에는 김치와 당면, 두부와 야채가 보들보들한 얇은 만두피에 가득 차 있고, 양지와 사태를 오랜 시간 우려낸 깔끔하고 시원한 국물이 함께 나온다. 양념한 고기 고명이 올라가는 만둣국은 김치만두와 두부만두 중에서 선택이 가능하며 국물의 진한 감칠맛과 잘 어울린다.
맷돌에 곱게 갈아 만든 녹두전은 포슬포슬한 질감에 숙주나물의 아삭함이 더해져 부드럽고 바삭한 식감이 일품이다. 작지만 깔끔하게 유지되는 공간에서 사장님과 가족들이 만둣국을 직접 만든다. 마음이 따뜻해지는 만둣국 한 그릇을 이곳에서 꼭 경험해 보기를 바란다.

records.name: 1969 부원동 칼국수
records.description:
직접 제면한 쫄깃한 칼국수 면, 해물과 야채로 끓인 맑고 진한 감칠맛의 국물, 계절과 선도에 따라 엄선된 굴, 홍합, 조개의 조화가 이곳의 특징이다. 덕분에 남녀노소 누구나 편하고 맛있게 음식을 즐길 수 있다.
또 다른 별미인 비빔 칼국수를 주문하면 적절한 매운맛과 감칠맛이 어우러진 부산식 비빔 스타일을 제대로 느낄 수 있다. 주문 시 양을 추가해 달라고 하면 사리를 넉넉히 담아 준다. 여름철에만 파는 국수 메뉴 외에는 두 종류의 칼국수와 만두가 전부인 단출한 메뉴이지만 그만큼 맛의 깊이가 있다.

records.name: 마츠자키
records.description:
작고 아담한 장소에서 즐기는 정통 가이세키 오마카세 전문점으로 어릴 적부터 자신만의 식당을 꿈꿨다는 젊은 셰프의 공간이다. 장소는 작지만 셰프가 하나둘씩 모은 고급 식기와 와인잔부터 어머니가 그린 그림으로 우아하게 꾸민 공간과 정성 가득한 음식이 준비되어 있다.
감칠맛이 풍부한 국물 요리로 시작해 작은 계절 요리가 아름답게 모여 있는 핫슨, 솥에 갓 지은 밥과 야채와 생선을 넣은 나베 요리까지 기본에 충실한 일식을 선보인다.

records.name: 미락슈퍼
records.description:
예전의 간판이 여전히 걸려 있는 미락슈퍼는 좌석 6개가 전부인 아담한 공간에서 셰프의 개성이 듬뿍 담긴 요리를 선보이는 식당이다. 마당에서 직접 키운 채소와 냉장고에서 숙성시킨 생선과 고기, 그날의 좋은 제철 재료로 코스를 짜서 제공한다.
특히 숯불에 구워 향과 염도, 식감과 육즙을 모두 살린 고기 구이와 쌀밥의 한상차림은 양식으로 시작해 한식으로 끝내는 맛의 밸런스를 잘 보여 준다. 이색적인 맛의 조합이 주는 밸런스를 느끼고 싶다면 이 작은 식당을 찾아가 보자. 메뉴가 정해지지 않고 매일 바뀌는 재미가 쏠쏠하다.

records.name: 우나쥬
records.description:
청사포 언덕 위 고즈넉한 장소에 위치한 우나쥬. 검은색의 세련된 외관에 널찍한 주차 공간을 갖춘 이곳은 나고야에서 1948년 창업한 ‘시라카와’의 레시피를 이어받아 한국에 선보인다. 초벌구이 장어를 다시 한번 구워 쫄깃하고 바삭한 식감을 더해 씹는 맛을 살렸는데 특제 타레 소스를 추가해 밥과 함께 먹으면 적당한 단맛과 감칠맛, 식감을 동시에 느낄 수 있다.
함께 제공되는 고추냉이와 녹차, 김가루를 넣어 오차즈케로 먹어도 색다른 맛을 느낄 수 있다. 점심 특선 메뉴에는 냉우동과 튀김 요리가 포함되어 있는데 하루 30개만 예약 판매된다고 하니 미리 고려해 방문하기를 권한다.

records.name: 울트라 바이트
records.description:
광안리 작은 골목길 끝에 보이는 울트라바이트. 세련된 파사드에 큰 유리창 안으로 보이는 내부의 은은한 조명과 와인병이 아늑한 분위기를 자아낸다. 젊은 셰프들이 운영하는 이 공간은 그 분위기에 걸맞게 편하게 즐길 수 있는 세련된 요리와 와인을 제공한다. 호주와 서울에서 경험을 쌓고 돌아온 셰프들이 각자의 경험과 창의성을 십분 활용해 재기 발랄한 음식들을 만들어낸다.
통으로 구운 한치는 앤쵸비 크림과 라르도, 발효한 토마토 피클을 사용하는데 식감이 쫄깃할 뿐 아니라 부드러운 소스의 맛과 상큼한 토마토의 절묘한 밸런스가 와인과 잘 어우러진다. 큰 새송이 버섯에 튀김옷을 입혀 통째로 튀긴 후 달콤하고 매콤한 생강 소스를 입혀 낸 튀김은 마치 버섯 탕수를 먹는 느낌을 주고 함께 나오는 라임 주스와 김가루가 독특한 맛을 더한다.

records.name: 이안
records.description:
달맞이고개에 자리 잡은 이곳은 젊은 셰프가 본인의 이름을 따 지은 공간으로 프렌치와 한식을 기반으로 과감한 컨템퍼러리 음식을 선보이는 중이다. 토마토 화채, 들깨 비빔면 등 한식의 이름을 사용하지만 음식의 소스와 플레이팅에는 프렌치 요리 기법을 활용했다.
특히 소스의 밸런스를 살리는 능력이 뛰어나 앞으로가 더 기대된다. 푹신한 카페트와 심플한 테이블이 음식처럼 포근하고 단아한 느낌을 준다. 조용한 공간에서 와인과 함께 식사를 즐겨 보는 것도 좋을 것이다.

records.name: 잔둔가
records.description:
조용한 골목에 자리한 이 레스토랑은 높은 천장, 오픈 키친과 바 카운터를 갖춘 인더스트리얼 시크한 공간으로, 멕시코에서 받은 영감과 경쾌한 음악이 더해져 편안한 분위기를 만든다. 멕시코 요리에 대한 깊은 애정과 잦은 현지 방문을 바탕으로 젊은 셰프가 부산에 문을 연 곳이다.
메뉴는 간결하지만 토르티야부터 속재료, 소스까지 모두 직접 만들어 신선도가 뛰어나며, 다양한 옥수수 품종으로 색감과 풍미를 살린 토르티야는 아침마다 갓 준비한다. 대표 메뉴인 ‘포크 타코’는 촉촉하고 부드러운 돼지고기에 아보카도와 하우스 소스가 균형을 이루어 풍부한 맛을 선사한다. 따뜻하고 세심한 서비스가 전체 경험을 완성한다.

records.name: 진돼지곰탕
records.description:
2024년에 문을 연 후 부산의 젊은 세대에게 빠르게 사랑받고 있는 곳으로, 큰 간판이 걸린 건물 2층에 자리해 찾기 쉽다. 아담하지만 매력적인 공간은 U자형 바 카운터로 구성되어 활기차면서도 아늑한 분위기를 만든다.
메뉴는 단 10가지로 구성된 간결한 관광객 친화형이며, 대표 메뉴는 지리산 지역의 버크셔K 흑돼지를 사용해 맑고 담백한 국물이 특징인 돼지국밥이다. 수육 냉채 역시 놓칠 수 없는 메뉴로, 일정하게 썰린 삼겹살 부드럽고 입안에서 녹듯 풍미가 깔끔하다.

records.name: 토오루
records.description:
토오루에서는 당일 수급하는 해산물을 중심으로 짜여진 오마카세는 셰프의 재량에 따라 다양한 맛을 선보인다. 계절감을 존중하는 일본 요리의 특징을 살려 한국의 제철 식재료를 능숙하게 활용한다. 특히 국내산 제철 해산물에 집중하여 정통 레시피를 반영한 다양한 요리들은 화려하지는 않지만 토오루만의 담백한 맛을 보여 준다.
스리나가시 스타일이나 계절 식재료에 따라 소스에 다양한 변화를 주는 소멘 요리에서 셰프만의 개성을 느낄 수 있다. 은은하게 오래 구워 낸 바삭한 장어 요리도 빼놓을 수 없는 메뉴다.

records.name: 평산옥
records.description:
네 대(代)에 걸쳐 전통의 맛을 이어온 부산의 가족 운영 식당 평산옥은 오랜 역사와 변함없는 정통성으로 지금도 지역민에게 사랑받는 곳이다. 부산역에서 도보 몇 분 거리로 접근성이 좋으며, 소박한 동네 식당 같은 분위기가 시간의 흐름을 고스란히 담아내어 아늑하고 향수 어린 매력을 전한다.
메뉴는 수육과 국수 단 두 가지에 집중하며, 여름철에는 열무국수가 계절 한정으로 더해진다. 가격은 부담 없고 1인당 수육 1인분 주문이 원칙이라 혼밥 손님에게도 적합하다. 국내산 돼지고기를 사용한 수육은 지방과 살코기의 비율이 균형 잡힌 부위를 골라 천천히 삶아 잡내 없이 부드러운 식감과 담백한 풍미를 살려내는 것이 특징이다.

records.name: 모먼트 로컬
records.description:
자연 소재를 활용한 밝고 모던한 공간의 모먼트 로컬은 일반 테이블과 바 카운터, 야외 좌석, 프라이빗 룸까지 다양한 좌석을 갖추고 있다. 특히 조리 과정을 가까이에서 즐기고 싶다면 바 카운터를 추천한다.
이곳의 중심은 2~3주간 웻에이징해 깊고 진한 풍미를 끌어낸 한우다. 매일 엄선한 다양한 부위를 선보여 원하는 식감과 풍미에 따라 선택하는 재미가 있으며, 셰프는 비장탄의 화력을 섬세하게 조절하고 그릴링과 레스팅을 반복해 각 부위에 알맞은 익힘과 육즙을 구현한다.
세심한 코스의 구성과 마지막에 제공되는 수제 파스타가 풍성한 식사를 만족스럽게 마무리한다. 특히 샤토브리앙을 맛볼 수 있는 날이라면 놓치지 말 것. 섬세한 마블링에서 비롯된 풍부한 육즙과 부드럽게 녹아드는 안심 특유의 식감이 이곳 한우의 매력을 잘 보여준다.

records.name: 양경옥
records.description:
밝을 ‘양’, 빛날 ‘경’, 집 ‘옥’ 자를 써서 ‘밝게 빛나는 집’을 뜻하는 양경옥은 직접 뽑은 면과 감칠맛 나는 육수로 이름난 평양냉면집이다. 옛날 주택을 개조하고 주방을 널찍하게 조성해 청결한 환경을 한눈에 확인할 수 있다.
주문과 동시에 면을 뽑아 식감이 더욱 쫄깃하고 부드럽다. 고소한 육향과 메밀향, 슴슴한 육수에 쫄깃한 고기와 탄력 있는 국수의 밸런스가 좋고 상큼한 배추와 무가 감칠맛을 돋운다. 불고기와 편육도 곁들일 수 있으니 함께 즐겨 보시기를 바란다.

records.name: 거대 돼지국밥
records.description:
거대국밥은 돼지국밥을 중심으로 맑은 육수와 진한 육수 중 취향에 따라 선택할 수 있으며, 따로국밥으로도 주문할 수 있다. 그중에서도 추천할 만한 것은 진한 거대국밥이다. 국산 돼지고기와 뼈를 여덟 시간 이상 푹 고아낸 뽀얀 육수는 묵직한 질감과 진한 육향을 품고 있으며, 별도의 간을 하지 않아 육수 본연의 깊은 맛을 온전히 느낄 수 있다.
먼저 그대로 맛본 뒤 국산 천일염으로 담근 이 집만의 새우젓을 더하면 감칠맛과 염도가 자연스럽게 어우러지며 국물의 풍미가 한층 선명해진다. 함께 맛볼 수 있는 돼지 수육 역시 지방과 살코기의 비율이 적절하고, 부드러우면서도 쫄깃한 식감과 좋은 고기 맛이 돋보인다. 취향에 따라 다진 마늘이나 파김치를 조금씩 더하면 국물의 인상이 달라져, 한 그릇 안에서도 다양한 맛의 변화를 즐길 수 있다.

records.name: 샤브니지
records.description: 100년 가까이 된 적산가옥이 일본 전통 료칸을 연상시키는 세련된 공간으로 재해석되었다. 다양한 육수와 한우 1++ 등급의 고기를 제공하며, 아름다운 조경과 특색있는 식사를 즐길 수 있는 곳.

records.name: 디귿
records.description: 매일 새벽 계육공장에서 직배송 받은 싱싱한 닭을 섬세한 성형을 거쳐 고급 비장탄으로 구워낸다. 의외로 높은 연령대의 손님들이 자주 찾는다는 이곳은 상호를 닭의 초성 디귿에서 따올 만큼 야키토리에 진심을 담고 있다.

records.name: 이태리 삼촌
records.description: 두툼한 고기를 바삭하게 튀기고, 직접 만든 돈까스 소스를 사용한다. 아늑한 분위기에서 식사를 즐길 수 있는 곳으로 진심을 담아 언제나 촉촉하고 부드러운 돈까스를 만들고 있다.

records.name: 기장해변짚불곰장어
records.description: 매일같이 들여오는 곰장어를 짚불에 구워 신선함을 맛으로 느낄 수 있다. 곰장어는 양념으로도 먹을 수 있고, 오너가 직접 조리하는 반찬이 제공되는데 특히 열무물김치가 각별한 맛을 자랑한다.

records.name: 레스토랑 엠비언스
records.menu:
런치 ￦88,000
디너 ￦149,000
(계절에 따라 가격변동될 수 있음)
records.description: 다시마, 미역 등 지역의 신선한 재료를 공급받고 사용하여 정성스럽게 맛을 풀어내는 컨템퍼러리 한식 다이닝으로, 기장의 풍경과 잘 어울리는 이 공간은 2년간의 논의 끝에 완성되었다고 한다.

records.name: 만세담
records.description: 다양한 수상경력을 가진 한식명인 박경례 셰프의 식당으로, 명인이 직접 가마솥에 끓여 만든 곰탕을 찾아오는 사람들이 많다. 함께 제공되는 반찬도 직접 농사지은 제철 채소들로 만든 것이다.

records.name: 일광바다횟집
records.description: 일광읍 최대 어항인 학리항에서 공수한 신선한 제철 수산물로 음식을 준비하는 이곳은, 특히 유명한 멸치쌈밥 외에도 계절별로 인기 높은 메뉴들을 만날 수 있다.

records.name: 미소오뎅
records.description: 해가 지면 언제나 사람들로 북적이는 곳으로 오뎅바가 주는 정겨운 분위기에 취해 옆 좌석의 모르는 사람과도 편하게 대화를 나누게 되는 소박하고 마음 편한 공간이다.

records.name: 정재집
records.menu:
버섯크림 베이컨 뇨끼 ￦18,000
디 나폴리 에 루꼴라 ￦17,000
records.description: 그야말로 유럽의 한적한 골목 안 비스트로 같은 곳으로 뇨끼가 유명한 이탈리안 전문점이다. 아늑한 실내 공간은 위생적이며, 친절한 서비스와 맛있는 음식을 제공한다.

records.name: 오성집
records.description: 두툼한 고기를 점원이 솜씨있게 구워주는 이곳은 육즙이 풍부한 제주 생고기를 사용하는 것으로 유명한 구이 전문점으로 함께 제공되는 매콤한 콩나물찜이 고기 맛을 더욱 풍부하게 만든다.

records.name: 귀화식당 사케의향
records.description: 다양한 구성의 숙성사시미와 파인 다이닝에서 만날 수 있을 것 같은 섬세한 요리들 그리고 다양한 사케리스트가 반가운 곳으로 그야말로 명물인 오무라이스까지 일본현지의 맛을 즐길 수 있는 곳.

records.name: 당미옥 한우곰탕 온천본점
records.description: 1986년 시작하여 2대째 운영 중인 이곳은 육가공 공장부터 경매 등 좋은 품질의 소를 직접 선별하여 사용한다. 천천히 시간을 들여 고아내는 진한 육수에 푸짐하게 고기가 들어간 곰탕을 만날 수 있다.

records.name: 석정갈비
records.description: 축산학을 전공한 축산물 전문가가 운영하는 곳으로 300시간의 저온 숙성과 15mm의 절묘한 두께, 4mm 간격의 정교한 칼집으로 준비된 고기와 부모님이 농사지은 채소를 사용하여 직접 만든 반찬을 제공하고 있다.

records.name: 주문진막국수
records.description: 프로야구의 성지인 사직야구장 근처에 있는 아주 유명한 식당으로, 여름에는 정말 오래 기다려야 음식을 맛볼 수 있다. 부산의 대표적인 막국수전문점인 이곳은 두툼하면서도 극단적으로 부드러운 돼지수육이 더욱 유명하다.

records.name: 쿠루미 과자점
records.description: 직접 키운 다양한 천연 발효종을 사용하고 쉽게 구할 수 없는 다양한 밀가루를 블랜딩하여 빵을 만들고 있는 곳으로 부산의 빵집 투어를 계획하는 사람이라면 꼭 방문 계획을 잡는 곳이다.

records.name: 갓포현
records.description: 최고의 제철 재료를 사용하여 정통 일본식 갓포 요리를 만드는 현영길 셰프의 가게로 오랜 경력이 담겨있는 수준 높은 코스와 단품 요리를 만날 수 있다. 서면에서 오랜 시간 사랑받아 온 곳이다.

records.name: 갯마을횟집
records.description: 봄여름에는 자연산 도다리, 가을과 겨울에는 감성돔 딱 두 가지 회만 취급하고 있는 곳으로 이틀에 한 번 직접 공수한 횟감을 소박하고 푸짐하게 담아준다. 1976년 개업하여 2대에 걸쳐 운영 중인 곳.

records.name: 야키쵸리
records.description: 좌석에 앉아 숯불에 구워지는 꼬치구이를 보고 있으면 왠지 일본 현지의 이자카야에 온 듯한 분위기가 난다. 전포동 골목의 작은 꼬치구이 전문점인 이곳에서는 신선한 닭을 사용한 여러 부위의 꼬치구이를 즐길 수 있다.

records.name: 야키토리 온정
records.description: 매일 아침 손수 손질한 국내산 토종닭을 불 앞에서 한 꼬치씩 정성스럽게 구워 오마카세 구성으로 제공하는 이곳은, 닭의 각 부위가 가장 매력적인 맛을 내도록 구운 꼬치구이를 손님에게 제공하고 있다.

records.name: 융캉찌에 서면점
records.description: 대만의 유명한 거리인 ‘융캉제’를 상호로 하는 대만음식 전문점으로 현지 느낌을 물씬 풍기는 이곳에서는 한국인의 입맛에 맞게 구현한 진한 국물의 우육탕면과 매콤한 탄탄면을 만날 수 있다.

records.name: 나룻터국수
records.description: 좋은 품질의 디포리, 멸치 등을 사용하여 육수를 만들고, 직접 담근 깍두기와 김치를 사용해 손님을 맞이한다. 전통적인 수제 방식으로 떼어내 쫄깃한 식감을 자랑하는 수제비가 유명하다.

records.name: 레썽스
records.menu:
디너 테이스팅 코스 ￦180,000
런치 테이스팅 코스 ￦80,000
records.description: 메뉴 전반에 직접 만든 천연 식초와 간장, 된장을 사용하고, 정통 프렌치 기법에 한국의 제철 식재료와 발효, 절임 기술이 결합된 음식을 만드는 이노베이티브 프렌치 레스토랑으로 오픈 키친을 통해 조리 과정을 즐길 수 있는 곳.

records.name: 브런치식당 소보
records.description: 최소 15가지 이상의 신선한 계절 야채를 굽고, 찌고, 삶아 속이 따뜻하고 편안한 음식을 만드는 곳으로, 시골의 부모님이 직접 수확한 믿을 수 있는 계절채소를 사용하고 있다.

records.name: 안목
records.description: 오픈주방을 중심으로한 바 테이블구조의 내부가 일식 라멘가게를 연상시키지만 이곳은 분명히 돼지국밥전문점으로 부산의 대표음식인 돼지국밥을 현대적인 감각으로 재해석하여 인기 높은 곳이다.

records.name: 서가원 국수
records.description: 파주 장단콩을 하루 전에 불려 신안 천일염과 물로만 맛을 내는 이곳의 콩국수는 크림처럼 부드럽고 담백하게 고소한 맛으로 유명하다. 남해 멸치로 육수를 낸 잔치국수도 인기있다.

records.name: 쉐프곤
records.description: 오랜 호텔식당경력의 셰프가 아침마다 신선한 재료를 직접 구하여 계절에 맞는 메뉴를 구성한다. 자신 있게 준비한 ‘자갈치 셰프 코스 스페셜’은 또 다른 자갈치를 경험하게 해 줄 것이다.

records.name: 거대곰탕
records.description: 엄선한 한우 사골뼈를 전통적인 방식으로 오랜 시간 우려내 진하고 부드러운 국물을 자랑하는 곳으로 다양한 스타일의 곰탕을 제공한다. 세계적으로 인정받는 한국의 국물 요리를 목표로 한다.

records.name: 도핀느
records.description: 프랑스 파리의 샤퀴테리 전문점에서 근무하고, 현지에서 자격도 취득한 경험이 담겨있는 곳으로 모든 제품을 직접 만드는 프렌치 샤퀴테리 전문점. 식사가 되는 요리형 샤퀴테리를 지향하는 곳이다.

records.name: 무스비
records.description: 현대적인 느낌의 다양한 소바요리를 선보이는 곳으로 일본식 메밀면을 직접 만든다. 청어조림소바, 구운고등어소바가 비린 맛 없이 담백하고 풍부한 맛으로 인기 높고 새우튀김과 타마고야키 등의 사이드 메뉴도 준비되어 있다.

records.name: 신도랩 2.0
records.description: 1975년 부산에서 아홉 번째로 생긴 정육점 ‘신도축산물유통’을 리뉴얼하고 그 정체성을 이은 신도마켓 신도랩의 두 번째 공간으로, 코스요리인 1.0과 달리 2.0은 스테이크&오이스터바로 운영하고 있다.

records.name: 양산국밥
records.description: 해운대에서 3대를 이어 운영 중인 곳으로 부산식의 맑은 돼지국밥을 만든다. 맑은 국물이 밥을 토렴해서 먹기 좋은 온도로 나오는 것이 특징이며, 토렴방식의 장점을 높일 수 있는 유기그릇을 사용하는 것이 특이하다.

records.name: 옥이보리밥
records.description: 매일 아침 정성 들여 준비한 10가지 나물과 반찬으로 보리밥 한상을 차리는 이곳에서는 매일같이 정직한 한 끼 식사를 고집스럽게 준비하고 있다.

records.name: 율링
records.menu:
스페셜 런치 코스 ￦120,000
스페셜 디너 코스 ￦215,000
records.description: 미쉐린 3스타 레스토랑인 도쿄의 ‘SÉZANNE’, 1스타 레스토랑 ‘라망 시크레’ 출신 김성주셰프와 한국 대회 우승자이자 아시아 소믈리에 대회 국가대표인 박민욱소믈리에가 함께 만들어내는 컨템포러리 다이닝 레스토랑

records.name: 피오또
records.description: 팜투테이블을 지향하는 부부 셰프가 부모님과 함께 직접 농사지은 재료로 코스를 구성했다. 사용되는 채소는 모두 직접 수확한 농작물이며 다른 식재료는 지역의 식재료를 사용하는 지역 중심의 레스토랑으로, 좋은 재료를 사용한 좋은 음식을 만든다.

records.name: 쥬가정효
records.description: 다년간 일본 교토에서 카이세키요리를 수련한 오너가 엄선된 계절 식재료를 사용하여, 코스 요리를 준비했다. 일본술(사케)와 무척 어울리는 코스 구성이 특징이다.

records.name: Mandeuri Gondeurebap (만드리곤드레밥)
records.menu: Stone Pot Gondeure Set,  Smoked Duck in Pumpkin
records.description:
Usually, dried gondeure (Korean thistle) is used for gondeurebap (thistle rice).
But this place uses fresh gondeure and cooks it in a stone pot.
Stone pot gondeure set with doenjang jjigae and over ten side dishes is most popular

records.name: Manho Galmi Shabu-shabu (만호갈미샤브샤브)
records.menu:
Hen Clam Shabu Shabu ￦50,000-80,000
Hen Clam Samgyeopsal ￦50,000-80,000
records.description: The restaurant specializes in hen clams and offers a variety of dishes-shabu-shabu, steamed, and grilled. Also famous for their hearty soup, hen clam shabu shabu and steamed clams are the top picks.

records.name: MinmulGarden (민물가든)
records.menu: Braised Carp with Aged Kimchi,  Braised Carp
records.description: This braised fish restaurant has been operating for 30 years,known for cooking traditionally with wooden steamers. Using seasoning made from more than 20 different ingredients, their most famous dishes are braised carp with aged kimchi and braised carp.

records.name: Booheung Sikdang (부흥식당)
records.menu:
Jaridomhoe(Raw Slices of Pearl Chromis) ￦30,000
Jaridommulhoe(Raw Slices of Pearl Chromis with Cold Soup) ￦12,000
records.description:
This is a popular pearl-spot chromis specialty shop in Yeongdo. The fresh fish goes nicely with
their original sauce. Also famous for their Jeju cutlassfish dishes, the restaurant only sells a
limited number of dishes every day

records.name: Samihun (사미헌)
records.menu: Galbitang (Beef shortrib soup), Myeongjang Set (Master’s Set)
records.description:
This is a famous Hanwoo beef specialty restaurant visited by heads of state from Korea and abroad.
The delectable meat is meticulously and diligently prepared by a skilled Hanwoo master.
It is also equipped with private rooms that are great for various banquets and events.

records.name: Wonjo Halmae Nakji (원조할매낙지)
records.menu:
Nakgopsae(small octopus/pork intestines/
shrimp) ￦11,000
Various toppings ￦1,000
records.description:
One word is enough to introduce this place, which was established in 1968.
This is where Busan’s local food, “jobang nakji,” was born.
There’s nothing more to add.

records.name: GayaHalmaeMaemilmyeon (가야할매밀면)
records.description: This restaurant specializes in milmyeon (wheat noodles), a folk dish in Busan. They add more corn starch, which makes them more elastic than others. The broth is made by mixing pork bones, beef bones, various vegetables, and herbs.  The side dish of dumplings is also popular.

records.name: Gukje Milmyeon Main Branch (국제밀면 본점)
records.description: This place is widely recognized as one of the best spots for milmyeon, mainly for its exceptional taste. It is one of the most famous restaurants among Busan’s many wheat noodle restaurants. They present a distinct type of wheat noodles in beef bone broth. Elsewhere, the meat topping is usually cut by machines, but they are known for hand-pulled thin pieces of brisket.

records.name: Gaya Milmyeon (가야밀면)
records.description:
Gaya Milmyeon is a historic restaurant with 40 years of tradition, known for its refreshing broth. 
You can always find a long queue of people at mealtimes, but thanks to the large hall with 140 
seats, the wait is shorter than it seems. The dining space is delightfully clean at all times.

records.name: Darin Geoin tongdak
records.description: This famous restaurant has been in business for nearly 60 years, spanning three generations, and it has stuck to one menu item: fried chicken. It is always mentioned when talking about the best chicken in town.

records.name: Gimhae Sikdang (김해식당)
records.description:
This is a famous monkfish restaurant, often introduced on TV, serving dishes made of fresh
monkfish since 1980. Known for the generous portions of fresh monkfish and specialty cuts,
Gimhae Sikdang is also popular among foreign customers.

records.name: Mulkkong Sikdang (물꽁식당)
records.description: Handed down to the third generation, this 60-year specialty restaurant uses fresh monkfish to steam, braise, and make soup. The mild-tasting monkfish is their signature dish. Despite the old history, the restaurant is very clean.

records.name: Busan Myeongmul Hoet-jip (부산명물횟집)
records.menu:
Hoe Set Menu for 1 ￦40,000
Hoe(sliced raw fish) ￦110,000
records.description:
This is a very well-known restaurant specializing in raw fish (Korean-style sashimi) since 1946,
frequented by numerous celebrities. Their popular dish is a raw fish set menu with a plate of
sliced halibut, rich and nourishing meat and bone broth, and six side dishes.

records.name: Seongiljip
records.menu: Eel salt roast, Eel seasoned roast
records.description:
In operation for 74 years, through three generations since 1950, it is one of the most famous hagfish restaurants in the country. 
It uses fresh domestic hagfish and a special seasoning made from 23 different Korean herbs.

records.name: Lee Jaemo Pizza Main Branch (이재모피자 본점)
records.description: This is a 30-year-old pizzeria, which has a very long tradition considering when pizza actually became popular in Busan. Characterized by generous toppings and Imsil cheese, the pizza is as tasty as ever.

records.name: Momos Coffee Main Branch (모모스커피 본점)
records.description: The winner of the 2019 World Barista Championship (WBC) is from this cafe, Momos Coffee, one of the most famous cafes in Busan, the city of cafes. It is a space full of love for coffee, offering high-quality beans that they roast themselves.

records.name: Baebijang Bossam Guseo Branch (배비장보쌈)
records.description:
It is one of the most famous bossam restaurants in Busan that have been operating for more than 
30 years. Bossam kimchi and muchae (shredded radish) is made every day. The steamed egg 
custard served as a side dish is very popular here, and it’s also a great place to entertain guests.

records.name: Jangsujang Kkorigomtang (장수장꼬리곰탕)
records.description:
Opened in 1983 and has been operating for more than 40 years, the restaurant makes kimchi and
jeotgal from scratch and preserves them in pots. It uses carefully selected ingredients, such as
Hanwoo bones and cartilage and the tails are from Australia.
The steady and unchanging quality keeps attracting its customers.

records.name: Geodae Galbi (거대갈비)
records.description: This Korean charcoal barbecue restaurant uses only the highest-grade meat and the best raw ingredients. The interior is clean, and the service is nice. The price is high as they serve the highest-grade Korean beef, but with the staff’s grilling service, it’s quite satisfactory.

records.name: Geumsubokguk Haeundae Main Branch (금수복국 해운대본점)
records.menu:
Eunbokguk(brown-backed toadfish soup)
clear / spicy broth ￦15,000 / 16,000
Milbokguk(green toadfish soup)
clear / spicy broth ￦22,000 / 23,000
records.hours:
1F Geumsubokguk Haeundae Branch 00:00-24:00
2F Pufferfish restaurant 11:00-22:00
2F (Break time 15:00-17:00 / Last order 13:30, 20:30)
records.description: This 50-year-old bokguk (pufferfish soup) restaurant is said to be the original bokguk restaurant. The secret to its flavor is its fresh ingredients, precise logistics system, and the fact that all the sauces are made from scratch. It is open 24 hours a day.

records.name: Daon (다온)
records.menu: Daon Set (1 serving) , Songari Set (1 serving)
records.description: This is a traditional Korean restaurant with an impressive interior that utilizes traditional Korean motifs. There are private rooms decorated with local accessories, and it is a popular venue for formal gatherings. Korean cuisine made with medicinal herbs and seasonal ingredients is popular as a course meal.

records.name: Dongbaekseom Hoetjip (동백섬횟집)
records.description: At this wild-caught raw fish (hwareohoe) restaurant, every order of hoe comes with a table full of side dishes such as steamed octopus, sea urchin, abalone, grilled flounder, fried prawns, and spicy fish stew. The cost of most fish fluctuates according to market prices.

records.name: Le Convive (르꽁비브)
records.description: Le Convive is an authentic French restaurant launched by OPS, a famous bakery in Busan. The chef, who has been teaching French cuisine in France, showcases various seasonal French courses with an authentic cooking style.

records.name: Panini Brunch (파니니브런치)
records.description:
It is a brunch cafe with a pretty exterior of a renovated house and a perfect, cozy interior for the holidays. An impressive flowerbed is shown beyond the window.
Popular items include American brunch,bulgogi panini, mac & cheese panini, burrito brunch, and ricotta salad.

records.name: Moon Sushi (문스시)
records.menu: Omakase Moon Sushi, Omakase Su Sushi
records.description: This Japanese restaurant is run by a famous celebrity chef. It features elegant and satisfactory dishes, in a sophisticated interior. The Omakase Sushi Course, which consists of dishes recommended by the chef, is particularly famous.

records.name: Halmae Jaecheopguk (할매재첩국)
records.menu:
Shellfish Soup ￦8,000
Jaecheop hoe(freshwater clam served raw) ￦10,000
records.description:
It is a jaecheopguk (freshwater clam soup) specialty restaurant that has been in business for 30 
years at the corbicula specialty town located alongside the Nakdong River. 
The popular way of enjoying the shellfish is making bibimbap with soybean paste and freshwater 
clam. and eating it with the soup.

records.name: Yeije (예이제)
records.description: Located near Haeundae Beach, this Hanjeongsik restaurant is a favorite for family gatherings and treating guests. Using seasonal ingredients selected by the owner and vegetables grown in a farm run by an acquaintance, this restaurant presents beautiful plates that you can’t help but admire before eating.

records.name: Hapcheon Illyu Dwaejigukbap (합천일류돼지국밥)
records.menu: Gogigukbap (meat soup with rice), Steamed Pork Set
records.description:
In the vicinity of Sasang Intercity Bus Terminal, famous for many delicious holes in the wall, this 
place is especially famous for pork soup. It is open 24 hours a day, and is also a popular spot for 
tourists. They are known for topping off the soup with heaps of ground garlic. Steamed pork is just 
as famous as their soup.

records.name: Wonjo Seokdae Chueotang (원조석대추어탕)
records.description: When you enter the entrance, you will see a pile of firewood and a large iron pot placed on the fireplace. This famous chueotang restaurant boils the soup for a long time on strong heat, which creates tender and rich flavor. They also offer tossed shellfish and braised stingray.

records.name: Waveon Coffee (웨이브온커피)
records.menu: Wolnae latte, Brazilian Campo Alegre drip coffee
records.description:
The name of this coffee roastery always comes up when discussing cafes and the sea.
It is known for serving a wide variety of coffee, including drip coffees using specialty beans
selected by a certified Q grader. It has seats and blankets for appreciating the view of the
beach outside

records.name: DaetiMulkkong (대티물꽁)
records.description: The renovated house has a cozy decor, filled with props that bring out the nostalgia of the older generation. It is a beloved neighborhood hole-in-the-wall that specializes in braised monkfish, and serves generous portions at affordable prices.

records.name: Wonjo 18beon Wandang (원조 18번 완당)
records.description:
Since 1947, this famous restaurant has been operating for three generations. 
The founder learned how to make wontons in Japan and developed it to accommodate the 
Korean palate. This is a historic restaurant that played an important part in establishing 
the food culture in Busan.

records.name: Halmae Bokguk (원조할매복국)
records.menu: Pufferfish Soup , Steamed White Pufferfish Meat
records.description: One of the 31 designated folk restaurants in Busan, it is the best-known pufferfish restaurant in the Mipo area, known as “pufferfish village.” Bokjiri, a clear broth from pufferfish, is the signature menu. You can also enjoy dishes such as pufferfish porridge, steamed pufferfish, pufferfish bulgogi, and braised pufferfish.

records.name: Zen Sushi (젠스시)
records.menu:
Dinner for one ￦150,000
Corkage per bottle ￦50,000
records.description: It is a famous Japanese restaurant in Haeundae, operated by the owner-chef who received a certificate of Master Chef. Zen Sushi is known for its strict kitchen atmosphere and attention to hygiene. A course meal consisting of 10 kinds of sushi, miso soup, egg custard, tempura, and more, is the top menu item.

records.name: Sinchang Gukbap (신창국밥)
records.description:
The famous restaurant was named Sinchang Gukbap, as it was established in 1969 at the Gukje 
Market in Sinchang-dong. This is the origin of clear-broth dwaejigukbap.
They insist on fresh ingredients and the traditional toryeom method, and their North Korean-style 
sundae made from scratch is also very popular.

records.name: Yennal Omakjip (옛날 오막집)
records.description: Established in 1958, Yennal Omakjip is a longtime local favorite for grilled beef innards. Their amazing grilled meats prove their history and taste even better with pickles and tossed vegetables offered on the side.

records.name: Pyeongan-do Jokbal (평안도족발)
records.description: This is a long-established jokbal shop that has been operating in one place for over 30 years, a long-time local favorite. This longstanding legend is known for the balanced, clean taste of pork hocks free of meaty odor. Naengchae jokbal and garlic jokbal are also very popular.

records.name: Hanwoo Sootbul Yanggopchang (한우숯불양곱창)
records.description: Located near Haeundae Jung-dong Station, this grilled tripe restaurant is especially known for the marinaded and grilled teugyang, stomach chamber 1. At the time of order, the special marinade is brushed on the meat, then the staff provides the grilling service. It has a very tender yet slightly chewy texture.

records.name: Ssangdungi Dwaejigukbap Main Branch (쌍둥이돼지국밥 본점)
records.description: It is a famous restaurant where you can see a long line during mealtime. Ssangdungi is one of the most popular dwaejigukbap (pork soup) restaurants in Busan, home of this local dish. They are famous for the tenderness of their pork meat.

records.name: Gugine Nakjibokkeum (국이네낙지볶음)
records.menu: Nakgopsae (Small octopus, pork intestines, shrimp stir-fry), Various toppings
records.description:
It is a popular nakjibokkeum (spicy small octopus stir-fry) specialty restaurant known for
generous portions and a relatively mild taste.
It has emerged as a new rising star among Busan’s competing octopus stir-fry places.
All of the side dishes can be self-refilled, and the service is always friendly.

records.name: Vegenarang (베지나랑)
records.menu: Bean Cutlet with Black Rice, Avocado roll
records.description:
Vegenarang is a vegan restaurant that uses flavors from clean veggie-based broth 
and serves simple salads as well as a la carte dishes.
The vegan menu is especially popular among foreign visitors.

records.name: Silla Hoetjip (신라횟집)
records.description:
A variety of mulhoe is available at this mulhoe restaurant.
The sauce includes over 10 ingredients and is aged for the savory taste, and the broth is made
from boiling Korean Dendropanax tree.
Their unique presentation uses frozen stone plates to serve raw fish.

records.name: Yichungjip5649
records.menu: Sirloin Tonkatsu, Fish Katsu, Hamburger Steak
records.description: With simple and modern decor, this gyeongyangsik (western-inspired cuisine) restaurant serves fresh sirloin tonkatsu with rich broccoli soup and seasonal green salad. The crispy tonkatsu goes wonderfully with their special sauce.

records.name: Chowonbokguk (초원복국)
records.menu:
Bokguk(pufferfish soup) ￦18,000
Bok suyuk(steamed pufferfish meat) ￦45,000
records.description: Chowonbokguk is a well-known restaurant specializing in pufferfish cuisine. Started by a father with 50 years of experience as a Japanese restaurant chef, it is now managed by his son, who was the first to obtain the special cooking license for pufferfish in Busan. The place is always packed with customers who want to taste their top-notch pufferfish dishes.

records.name: Seokhwa Hanjeongsik (석화한정식)
records.description: Each dish is presented in such a delicate way that it is almost too beautiful to eat. It is a fine-dining Korean restaurant popular for formal gatherings. Their signature dishes include the Hometown Hanjeongsik served with fried mushrooms and stir-fried abalones, and Mother’s Hanjeongsik served with steamed scallops, braised beef ribs, and grilled eel.

records.name: Naedang (내당)
records.menu: Ilpum Hansang (Weekday Lunch Special) for 1, Yeon Course (Course Meal) for 1
records.hours:
Monday-Friday 12:00-21:30 
(Break time 15:00-17:30) 
Saturday-Sunday 11:30-21:30 
(Break time 13:30-14:00) 
(Break time 16:00-17:00) 
(Break time 19:00-19:30)
records.description:
The restaurant is set in a quaint, old-fashioned house with a garden and pond, and serves a variety of traditional flavors of Korean food. 
It is an elegant place for all kinds of banquets.

records.name: Bong Sikdang (봉식당)
records.description: Run by a mother who formerly owned a Korean restaurant and a son who is a French chef, this restaurant features courses that utilize seasonal ingredients and a finishing meal of bossam hansang. It is also a popular venue for various events

records.name: Sinbarwon (신발원)
records.description: This famous restaurant is one of the two major dumpling shops in Busan Chinatown. You will find long lines of people regardless of the time. Specializing in Chinese bread and dumplings, this shop’s thick and fluffy dumplings, mainly the juicy meat dumplings, are popular.

records.name: Choryang 1941 (초량 1941)
records.description:
Located in Ibagu-gil, a tourist attraction in Dong-gu, this cafe renovated a house built by the Japanese who lived in Busan in 1941. The exterior and interior, including the surrounding environment,
are reminiscent of the day. The main menu is a variety of “milk” contained in pretty bottles designed by the cafe.

records.name: Halmae Gukbap (60년 전통 할매국밥)
records.description:
This is a restaurant specializing in pork soup with 60 years of tradition. It’s so famous that you 
have to wait longer than 30 minutes during meal times. Unlike most other pork soup, their dwaejigukbap has clear broth, and the roughly sliced pork meat is incredibly tender. 
The steamed meat set, which serves the pork broth and meat separately, is especially popular.

records.name: Hamgyeong Myeonok (함경면옥)
records.menu: Naengmyeon (Cold Noodles), Wang Galbitang, Dumplings Small
records.description: The taste of naengmyeon made by artisans for 30 years is hard to compare with others. It is one of the most famous naengmyeon restaurants in Busan, and the fact that many people always come, regardless of the season, proves the unchanging taste of this place.

records.name: Kim Yu-sun Daegu Ppoljjim (김유순대구뽈찜)
records.description: Also remembered by its old name, Chungmu Restaurant, this restaurant specializes in braised codfish cheek, characterized by the spicy marinade and a heap of onion slices. The unique presentation of braised codfish cheeks, which are topped with bean sprouts and spicy marinade, pairs well with makgeolli and is perfect when eaten with potato noodles.

records.name: Baeksan Kitchen (백산키친)
records.menu:
Assorted aged sliced raw fish
￦60,000-120,000
Sous vide steak ￦35,000
records.description: This Japanese-style izakaya restaurant uses seasonal ingredients to create a variety of dishes such as sliced raw fish, grilled dishes, and soup. People come here for drinks but end up very full. The service is friendly and pleasant, and the food is carefully prepared by experienced chefs.

records.name: Wakda Sikdang (왔다식당)
records.menu: Steamed tendon, Doenjang jeongol with tendons
records.description:
This Hanwoo tendon specialty restaurant that has been operating for more than 30 years is 
also frequented by Japanese guests. It only uses Hanwoo beef for the soft-textured tendons. 
If you are ordering doenjang jeongol, their signature item, it’s highly recommended to add 
ramen noodles.

records.name: Yeongbyeon Hoejip (영변횟집)
records.description:
This restaurant specializes in seggosi(sashimi), which is finely chopped hoe eaten with bones. Enjoy a variety of live fish such as flounder, halibut, rockfish, rock bream, and sea bass according to the season. Seggosi made with flounder or halibut are quite popular here. When you order hoe, the table is filled with side dishes and seafood.

※ Open as usual during the 2026 Lunar New Year holiday (Feb 16–18)

records.name: BANCO (방코)
records.menu:
Fungi Truffle Pizza ￦22,000
Fig and Blue Cheese Pizza ￦20,000
records.description: This restaurant with an eccentric exterior is home to pizzas and pasta baked in the oven. They use fresh ingredients and new recipes to create rich and light flavors. Truffle-flavored pizza and blue cheese pizza are the most popular dishes.

records.name: Gupochon Guksu
records.description:
The menu features only one noodle dish, using broth simmered for more than 12 hours with four or five of the South Coast’s finest anchovies. 
This renowned noodle shop has been in business for more than 30 years, spanning two generations, and can be recommended to anyone.

records.name: Eolkeuni Sonkalguksu
records.description: After eating shabu-shabu, you can cook them with noodles. They serve generous portions of ingredients compared to the price. First, after eating shabu-shabu, eat kalguksu made with that soup. Then they will make fried rice in the same pot.

records.name: Tambok Main Branch (탐복 본점)
records.menu:
Tambok Porridge, Tambok Rice ￦18,000
Tambok Gui(grilled abalone) ￦39,000
records.description: This casual Korean restaurant specializes in abalone dishes, such as Korean abalone served on beautiful plates and the signature abalone guts sauce. The architecture features a blend of traditional Korean and casual interiors in an old Hanok building.

records.name: Gonguk (곤국)
records.description: Gonguk is a gomtang (beef bone soup) specialty restaurant. Known for their longboiled soft meat and rich soup, the rice isn’t submerged in it but is prepared separately and freshly in a stone pot.

records.name: Dining Sen Busan (다이닝센 부산본점)
records.menu: Beef Chopped Steak Salad, Shoulder Pilaf
records.description: Family Restaurant Dining Sen makes its own special sauces, and serves quality food at a relatively low price. Facilities and space for events are also well prepared.

records.name: Gawon (Oryukdo Island)
records.description:
It has a beautiful architectural award-winning exterior and a large, well-groomed lawn garden.
Gawon is a famous charcoal-grilled Hanwoo(Domestic beef) restaurant that offers luxurious food
and service.

records.name: Haenam Kimchi Sikdang (해남식당)
records.menu: Aged Kimchi and Steamed Meat, Kimchi Jjigae with Aged Kimchi
records.description: This is a restaurant specializing in kimchi cuisine. Using cabbage from Haenam, famous for its cabbage production, they age their kimchi for a long time. You can eat a variety of kimchi dishes here. They are particularly proud of aged kimchi from Haenam.

records.name: Beomil Bindaetteok (범일빈대떡)
records.description:
It appeared on the famous cooking variety show called, “Baek Jong-won’s Top 3 Chef King.” 
It’s a bindaeddeok (pancake) shop, rare to find these days. Their classic dish is bindaeddeok with quaint sensibilities, made with 100% mung beans. It has a light yet savory taste.

records.name: Geumgang Mandu (금강만두)
records.description:
It was a hidden gem among the foodies,
but has now expanded into a large restaurant accessible to everyone.
Aside from mandu, the refreshing taste of yukgaejang is also very popular

records.name: Seokhwajeong (석화정)
records.menu: Oyster Soup with Rice, Raw oysters
records.description:
This is a restaurant specializing in oysters for 20 years. You can enjoy a variety of dishes made with 
oysters, such as fresh oysters, grilled oysters, fried oysters, oyster pancake, and oyster kimchi. 
In particular, an oyster soup made with fresh natural oysters is popular for its refreshing and rich 
flavor.

records.name: Aether (에테르)
records.description:
Located in the center of the Huinnyeoul Culture Village, this rooftop cafe consists of 4 floors
where you can admire the wonderful sea view of Yeongdo. You can enjoy light drinks and
desserts, but it also offers popular meals such as lobster rolls.

records.name: DESSERT CINEMA (디저트시네마)
records.description: Dessert Cinema bakes pastries such as croissants and pain au chocolat and sells them on the same day. The most popular item is the croissant, and if you arrive late, many items may be sold out.

records.name: Bukgyeong (Beijing) (북경)
records.description: Located in the center of Yeonsan-dong’s main streets, this Chinese restaurant is a favorite spot for local office workers’ company gathering. While everything on the menu is good, it is especially famous for its delicious jjajangmyeon noodles.

records.name: Yeonsan Nakji Haemultang (연산낙지해물탕)
records.menu: Seafood pot, Live Octopus Hot Pot
records.description: Any haemultang is filled with plenty of seafood, but the seafood pot here is packed with freshest of seafood that even those who don’t know much about ingredients can tell how fresh they are. When the seafood is almost ready, they add a live octopus before serving.

records.name: Otbada Jeonbok Samgyetang (옻바다 전복삼계탕)
records.menu: Chicken Soup with Lacquer Tree Chips, Samgyetang
records.description: The restaurant specializes in samgyetang(chicken soup) and serves onnamu samgyetang (chicken soup with lacquer tree chips), one of the most popular dishes for stamina, with sea abalone. Lacquer tree wine is also offered as an aperitif. This famous restaurant was also featured on TV shows.

records.name: Palmi Chobap (팔미초밥)
records.description: This restaurant is one of Busan’s best-known Japanese food restaurants, a great place for serving guests in the commercial area. It is run by an owner-chef with 30 years of experience, and the course meals at this restaurant are satisfying compared to the price.

records.name: Darijip (다리집)
records.description:
It is one of the most famous tteokbokki joints in Busan. Back when it was a pojangmacha
(street food vendor), only the legs of customers were seen from the outside; hence it earned
the name “house of legs (Darijip).” They are especially known for huge sizes of tteokbokki
and fried squid—just one piece is enough to make you full.

records.name: Namchon (남촌)
records.description:
It is a pork specialty shop that uses only black pork from the clean area below Jiri Mountain.
The black pork they serve has an entirely different texture and taste from the usual pork.
They are known for using 5-layered black pork belly with the rind.

records.name: Beijing Bicycle (북경의 자전거)
records.description: This Chinese restaurant features authentic Chinese-style interior, with dishes prepared by Chinese chefs. The noodles are made by traditional hand-pulling method, and with a variety of dishes, many regulars frequent this place.

records.name: Gwangalli Eonyang Bulgogi Busanjip (광안리 언양불고기부산집)
records.description: This 30-year-old Gwangalli Eonyang Bulgogi restaurant uses carefully selected 100% Korean beef cows and home-grown organic produce. This is one of those restaurants that doesn’t need much introduction.

records.name: Sikdang Samseon (식당 3선)
records.menu: Seasoned pork ribs, Gochujang pork ribs
records.description: This restaurant serves charcoal-grilled meat, green onion with pork belly, and wheat noodles. It has a large space and is popular as a place for family dining. The main dish is charcoal-grilled meat, which is convenient to eat as they serve them cooked.

records.name: Hamgyeong Myeonok (함경면옥)
records.description: This is a restaurant specializing in Hamheung naengmyeon with 22 years of tradition. Known for their signature Hamheung style of chewy noodles made of sweet potato starch, mulnaengmyeon with rich soup stock and hoe bibimmyeon topped fermented stingray hoe are the most popular dishes.

records.name: Hongokdang
records.menu: Red Bean bun, Sweet Red Bean Porridge
records.description: This small shop is located in an alley in front of Gwangalli Beach. It is a specialty store that uses only domestic red beans for its creations. It is famous for its red bean shaved ice, red bean porridge, and red bean buns. The buns are so popular that you often see long lines of customers who want to purchase them.

records.name: The 8ble Songdo Branch
records.description: This is the branch of the famous Western restaurant, The 8ble, where you can enjoy a special meal in the beautiful ocean view anywhere from the inside. The signature pizza is characterized by moist dough, and the spicy and aromatic pasta made with their special sauce is also popular.

records.name: Mongsil Jongga Dwaejigukbap (몽실종가돼지국밥)
records.description:
The restaurant is located near Gamcheon Culture Village. The interior is neat and friendly staff 
provide memorable service. It is famous for the soup made from boiling beef broth for more than 
24 hours. You can choose the amount and the cut of meat to eat with the soup.

records.name: Sikdang Toseong-dong (식당 토성동)
records.description: The petite, charming restaurant is located at an unexpected place, and is famous for its simple food, refreshing taste, and friendly service. Although all of the dishes are popular, the main menu is the bite-sized steak bowl with a mild taste through trimming and aging.

records.name: Cheongjuk (청죽)
records.description: With a beautiful garden that extends to the entrance, this Japanese restaurant specializes in course meals. It is a popular place for classy gatherings. Although it is relatively expensive, guests find it satisfying in both taste and service. Japanese courses are their main presentation.

records.name: Pyeonuibang (편의방)
records.description: Flashing a striking red signboard, Pyeonuibang is a Chinese dumpling shop operated by the third generation of owners. It is famous for samseon dumplings, which are limited to 40 servings per day, and must be ordered by phone 30 minutes in advance. Made at the time of order, juicy samseon dumplings are filled with various vegetables and prawns.

records.name: Dongwon Jangsuchon
records.menu: Herbal Duck Soup with Mung Beans, Chicken Soup with Neungi Mushroom
records.description:
This is a restaurant specializing in stamina cuisine, served in an earthen pot called
ddukbaegi made by master potters. It is also a popular place for group gatherings.
Hanbang nokdu baeksuk (herbal duck soup with mung beans) is a particularly popular dish. It
features medicinal herbs such as milk vetch roots, matrimony vine, and licorice, as well as mung
beans and duck boiled for a long time. The soup and the meat are deeply nourishing.

records.name: Pohang Gajami Mulhoe (포항가자미물회)
records.description: It is a simple neighborhood restaurant, and is famous for mulhoe, or noodles and hoe in cold soup. Hoe and broth seasoned with various sauces are served separately. It’s delicious to eat fish with fresh tomatoes in summer and seaweed in winter.

records.name: Gwaebeop Jjukkumi (괘법쭈꾸미)
records.description: This is one of the most popular restaurants specializing in webfoot octopus dishes in the region, which started in Gwaebeop-dong in 2007. It uses secret homemade sauce that creates this deliciously spicy flavor that you will crave again and again. The signature item is Well-Being Jjukkumi. Their secret to longstanding popularity is maintaining the quality of that single dish.

records.name: Gwangmyeongjip (광명집)
records.description: For over twenty years, this restaurant has been operated by generations of family members. They specialize in braised monkfish and codfish dishes made with fresh and quality ingredients. For braised codfish heads, their unique cooking style adds heaps of onions on top. Both braised fish dishes are popular.

records.name: Myeongjicheotjip (명지첫집)
records.menu: Jjukkumi Bossam M (Webfoot Octopus with Steamed Pork), Lunch special: Bossam set meal for two
records.description:
The signature dishes are generous servings of bossam jeongsik (steamed pork set meal) and
jjukkumi bossam (spicy webfoot octopus and steamed pork).
Side dishes include jeotgal (fish sauce) and green onion kimchi, each representing Myeongji’s
specialty ingredients: salt and green onion.

records.name: Yukmyeonjeong (명품외식 육면정)
records.menu: Beef Ribs 150g, Marinated Ribs 300g, Marinated Ribs 250g
records.description: Yukmyeonjeong is a large restaurant specializing in Korean barbecue, with various banquet halls, facilities for children, and a spacious parking lot. They serve high-quality beef and fresh vegetables and are certified with top ratings in hygiene. It’s an excellent place for groups and families to dine out.

records.name: Hopogalbi Munhyeon Branch (호포갈비 문현점)
records.description:
Customers buy meat from the butcher on the first floor at this restaurant and bring it up to the
second floor to grill and eat. It is known for the neat decor and cleanliness. The butcher section
has a wide selection of high-quality Hanwoo cuts for customers to choose from.

records.name: Pyeongsanok (평산옥)
records.menu: Steamed Pork, Noodles, Yeolmu Guksu (Cold Noodles with Young Radish)(Summer only)
records.description: Run by a family for four generations, this restaurant with a 100-year tradition is known for the steamed pork meats and noodles served with the soup from cooking meat. Made with fresh, domestic meat, the clear broth is nourishing and rich. The taste is nothing short of their longstanding history.

records.name: Gonggamsikdang (공감식당)
records.menu: Select Aged Pork Belly 130g, Select Aged Pork Shoulder 130g
records.description: Barley-fed pigs are selected and aged by specialists, then grilled by trained attendants at this Korean barbecue restaurant. Pork belly and cheese on the grill are their most popular items. You can also order a variety of side dishes.

records.name: Daom (Samjeong Tower Branch, Seomyeon) (다옴)
records.menu: Chadolbagi Bibimguksu (Mixed Noodles with Brisket), Kalguksu (Hand-cut Noodle Soup), Noodles, Bibimbap (Mixed Rice with Toppings)
records.description: Daom presents a casual Korean dining experience. The food is prepared with special care, from their broth made of anchovies from the southern coast to aged marinade mixed with fruit. Bibimguksu (mixed noodles) topped with beef brisket and bibimbap (mixed rice) are their signature dishes.

records.name: Danggammilmyeon (당감밀면)
records.menu: Milmyeon (Cold Wheat Noodle Soup), Bibimmilmyeon (Cold Mixed Wheat Noodles), Dumplings

records.name: Burger Shop (버거샵)
records.description: This handmade burger shop makes burgers with Grade 1 Hanwoo patties and brioche buns baked fresh every morning. It’s also frequented by many foreign customers. It features unique decor and also sells various merchandise.

records.name: Sosuin (소수인)
records.description: Sosuin is a Japanese-style bar that offers new Japanese-inspired dishes. Shortly after its opening, it started becoming packed with customers. Their distinct dishes make great meals and also pair well with drinks.

records.name: Yangpyeong Kalguksu (양평칼국수)
records.menu: Yangpyeong Kalguksu (Hand-cut Noodle Soup), Bibim Kalguksu (Mixed Hand-cut Noodles), Kalguksu with Anchovies, Meat Dumplings
records.description: At this restaurant located near Dadaepo Beach, the owner-chef with a 20-year experience in kalguksu (hand-cut noodle soup) makes their own ripened noodle dough and kimchi with domestic napa cabbage for a delectable dining experience. Cold noodles and cold noodles with soybeans are their popular summer-only specials.

records.name: Yeongjin Dwaeji Gukbap Main Branch (영진돼지국밥 본점)
records.menu:
Suyuk Baekban(Steamed Pork Set Menu)
￦14,000
Dwaejigukbap(Pork Soup with Rice) ￦10,000
records.description: It is one of the leading restaurants of Busan’s local food, dwaejigukbap, and is always crowded with customers. The distinct meat odor is removed for a refreshing taste, and their Suyuk Baekban with steamed pork, tofu, and stir-fried kimchi is very popular.

records.name: Sinheungbanjeom (신흥반점)
records.menu: Jjamppong (Spicy Noodle Soup with Seafood), Jajangmyeon (Black Bean Noodles), Spicy Garlic Chicken, Seafood Fried Rice
records.description: Sinheungbanjeom has been managed by two generations of a Chinese family for the past 55 years in Seo-gu. You can taste various Chinese dishes in an authentic atmosphere. Jjamppong soup and spicy garlic chicken are the recommended dishes.

records.name: Dongwon Sutbul Galbi (동원 숯불 갈비)
records.description: This is a hidden spot in a quiet alley specializing in pork ribs. They have stayed in one place for 38 years with just one dish: charcoal-grilled pork ribs. Despite the remote location, the restaurant has many regulars for the familiar flavor and steady quality.

records.name: Donald (도날드)
records.description: A famous nostalgic joint for the locals, Donald Tteobokki is a made-to-order tteobokki shop that has been in operation for 35 years. They are known for their original flavors with seafood broth and gochujang sauce. Many also come here for Ppeong Cream, an ice cream sandwich with ppeongtwigi (rice puff) sold as dessert.

records.name: Young Dough (영도우)
records.description: Young Dough is a pizzeria with a wide view of the Busan Port. The signature dish is the square Detroit-style pizza without the crust, made with their original dough. They use Imsil cheese generously to give a rich flavor to the pizza.

records.name: Hamheung Bossam (함흥보쌈)
records.menu: Assorted Bossam (Steamed Pork), Hamheung Naengmyeon, Pyeongyang Naengmyeon
records.description: Originally a naengmyeon (cold noodle soup) restaurant, it has become a bossam (steamed pork) restaurant and has been in operation for over 50 years. They are famous for using fresh meat and soft texture. Their long-standing-item, naengmyeon, is still popular, and every order is generously portioned.

records.name: Wonsanmyeonok
records.description: Wonsanmyeonok is a longstanding naengmyeon (cold noodle soup) establishment with 60 years of history, run by third-generation family members. They use Hanwoo, domestic pork, and fresh chicken, and the naengmyeon broth made of over 10 ingredients boasts the same flavor every time.

records.name: Gaemijip Sindosi Branch (개미집신도시점)
records.description: It is a branch of Gaemijip, Busan’s most famous stir-fried octopus chain, but the taste here is just as great as the original. Just as the original store, it serves stir-fried octopus, stir-fried octopus with shrimp, and stir-fried octopus, tripe, and shrimp. All of them are popular. Many customers also order bulgogi hot pot with octopus and mushroom and tripe hot pot.

records.name: Orihansang (오리한상)
records.menu: Grilled duck with salt, Grilled duck with seasoning
records.description: Salt-grilled mallard duck and thinly sliced quick-frozen duck barbecue are both popular dishes. It has a large window and a clean and spacious space, as well as private rooms that are great for family dining.

records.name: Manpo Milmyeon (만포밀면)
records.description: When you enter the store, the smell of rich broth makes you anticipate the flavors. Known for their Gaya-style wheat noodles, they start each day since opening in 1995 by tasting the wheat noodles for sale that day. It is always a pleasure to discover a consistent spot.

records.name: Matsarangchae (맛사랑채)
records.description: With 12 side dishes, including grilled fish and a different soup every day, the set meal here tastes more home-cooked food than real home cooking. Many customers come from far away to try their hearty meal.

records.name: Ujeong Kkamangchon Dwaeji (우정까망촌돼지)
records.description: This restaurant specializes in grilling and sources pork from clean environments to reproduce the taste of the pork they ate in the countryside as a child. They use the lid of a Korean cauldron called sot as the grill. It not only tastes delicious but makes your mouth water while it’s being grilled.

records.name: Geumnang Hoetjip, Gwanalli Main Store (금랑횟집 광안리 본점)
records.description: It is a hoe restaurant located in the waterside park hoe center. Many different kinds of dishes are served with the main dish, and are all very high in quality, so even those who don’t enjoy hoe can have a great time here. It is also famous for its seascape with a panoramic view of the Gwangan Bridge.

records.name: Nanpasen
records.description: It is a popular tendon (tempura overrice) restaurant that uses only good ingredients and special sauce. The chefs do a lot of research to make tempura that goes well with rice. The brown color of tempura on top of rice is their signature.

records.name: Hwaguk Banjeom (화국반점)
records.description:
Hwaguk Banjeom is a 43-year-old Chinese restaurant specializing in ganjjajang. It is 
renowned for the traditional style of cooking beloved by foreign visitors. It is also famous 
as a filming location for films like New World and the Nameless Gangster.

records.name: Royal Gyeongyangsik & Steak, Gwangan Branch
records.description: At this family restaurant, you can enjoy a meal while enjoying the sea view of Gwangalli. For the price, it offers a great quality of food and service. It has an open kitchen where customers can watch the food being prepared, and the indoor environment allows you to enjoy an impressive view of the sea.

records.name: Bonchamchi (본참치)
records.description: This is a famous tuna restaurant that attracts tuna lovers from all over the country. It is run by an owner-chef who is a master cook. All the ingredients are used up within the day. They also contribute to the local community by holding events for the elderly.

records.name: Mugunghwa
records.description: This restaurant makes you feel like you are at your grandmother’s house. It’s very famous for hotpot dishes, and the dumpling hotpot with large dumplings made from scratch is the most popular item. The vegetables are all fresh, and the dishes are always remembered for the consistent taste.

records.name: Eoga Chobap (어가초밥)
records.description: Eoga Chobap is a Japanese restaurant located adjacent to Jagalchi Market, the largest fish market in Busan. Most of the seating is in private rooms, so customers can enjoy their meals in comfort.

records.name: Baekkopsigye (배꼽시계)
records.menu: Duck Soup with Korean Dendropanax, Duck Soup with Neungi Mushrooms, Duck Bulgogi
records.description: This restaurant specializes in duck cuisine with herbal effects, cooking healthy food that patients covet to enjoy after surgery. They make pickles using seasonal ingredients and serve kimchi preserved for over two years. Because it takes a long time to cook duck soup, make reservations at least 2 hours in advance.

records.name: Sarangdo Hoetjip (사랑도 횟집)
records.menu: Wild Hoe, Uni Bibimbap, Mulhoe(Hoe with Cold Soup)
records.description: This restaurant selects and prepares quality hoe (Korean-style sashimi) every day and fills the table with side dishes made from scratch. Known for their integrity about food, this hoe restaurant is famous for having many regulars. The price may look slightly high at first, but once the food is served, it actually seems inexpensive for the quality.

records.name: Samsong Chobap Busan Nampo Main Branch (삼송초밥 부산남포동본점)
records.description: As one of the most well-known Japanese restaurants in Busan, it has a history of more than 65 years. Generations of customers guarantee its consistent taste. Their futomaki is especially popular.

records.name: Solivo (솔리보)
records.menu: Pomodoro Pasta, Shrimp Rose Pasta, Grilled Beef Steak
records.description: The young owner-chef, whose specialty is tomato sauce that he inherited and developed from his master, also dresses the meat used for steak himself and prepares it through a sous vide process for more than 8 hours. As the name suggests, the nicely decorated space makes you feel the warmth of the sunlight that shines through.

records.name: Busan Jokbal (부산족발)
records.description: Located in Bupyeong-dong Jokbal Alley, this is a famous restaurant that is often introduced on TV programs. It is also famous as the birthplace of naengchae jokbal (cold tossed pork hocks), a local delicacy of Busan. The restaurant’s light and chewy jokbal and naengchae jokbal are popular.

records.name: PHOever Yum (포에버얌)
records.menu: Wang Galbi Rice Noodles, Bun Cha, Fried Shrimp Roll
records.description: When you enter the store, it gives you the authentic feeling of a fishing village in Southeast Asia. This is a Vietnamese restaurant that makes all the broth and sauces from scratch. It is frequented by couples and families for the cozy atmosphere.

records.name: Mullebanga Jeukseokgui (물레방아 즉석구이)
records.description: This 45-year restaurant has been consistently receiving good reviews among gourmets. It is best known as the place that coined the term “angeummu” for hanging tenderloin. To live up to their name, they pay great attention to the selection of meat.

records.name: Yanggwibin Sikdang Branch No. 3
records.description: It is a restaurant specializing in roasted lamb, which is not yet common in Korea. The impressive decor may even pass as a cafe. When guests are seated, skilled staff will grill the meat for you. The owner, who studied Japanese cuisine, prepares high-quality lamb through a lot of research.

records.name: Gominkkeute Yeogi (고민끝에여기)
records.menu:
Shrimp Burrito, Pico del Gallo ￦11,000
Carnitas Taco ￦12,400
records.description: This restaurant prepares fresh corn tortillas in-house every day and strives to make Mexican dishes that are approachable even for first-time diners. All dishes are prepared with fresh ingredients that are newly prepared each day.

records.name: Myeongsong Chobap (명송초밥)
records.description: This Japanese restaurant is well-known for entertaining and gatherings in the commercial area. The delicate style of plating makes the elegant dishes stand out even more. They serve sashimi after aging them for two to three hours.

records.name: Take (다께)
records.menu: Take Kaiseki, Special Kaiseki 1, Special Kaiseki 2
records.description: Take is a famous Japanese restaurant in Beomil-dong, where the owner-chef prepares the main ingredients himself. If you contact them in advance, they may prepare the sashimi of your choice or the fish you freshly caught. Autographs of famous people on the walls guarantee the quality of this place.

records.name: Nampo Samgyetang (남포삼계탕)
records.description: Located near Gwangbok-ro Fashion Street, this is a famous samgyetang restaurant that has been open for more than 50 years. The signature menu, samgyetang, is a whole chicken stuffed with glutinous rice, ginseng, chestnuts, and jujubes in broth, served while boiling. Electric grilled chicken is also popular.

records.name: GAB148
records.address: 2F, Samik Beach B Shopping Mall, 122, Gwanganhaebyeon-ro
records.description: It is a dining pub frequented by couples with stunning indoor and outdoor terraces. The steak, the signature menu here, is popular because it is served on a stone heated to 250 degrees. Guests can taste various levels of steak, from rare to well-done.

records.name: Daesujeong (대수정)
records.menu: Sotbap Set Meal, Galbi Steamed Set Meal, Korean Beef Ttadak Set Meal
records.description: Daesujeong is a Korean restaurant that has been operating for more than 40 years. They make doenjang, soy sauce, and kimchi with ingredients sourced from their own farm and serve high-quality Korean beef. Their full tables served with rice in stone pots are delectable.

records.name: Mokjangwon (목장원)
records.description: Originally a cattle ranch, this place is one of the most famous restaurants in Yeongdo Island. It is a complex dining space with a restaurant, a cafe, and a park. The food is very good, but the view of the sea from this place is something else.

records.name: Tonshou
records.description: It is a famous pork cutlet specialty store that has a two-hour queue before opening. The thick but extremely soft meat is smoked over charcoal to create an amazing taste. They have a lounge area on the second floor for the customers in line.

records.name: Grazie (그라치에)
records.description: This small, cozy Italian restaurant with modern decor hopes to make Italian food more accessible to a wide audience. The potato gnocchi here is especially recommended by customers

records.name: Dongchon Hwang Jeong-sun Suyuk Jeongol (동촌황정순수육전골)
records.description: Their soup is rich without being spicy, and thick slices of meat that have been boiled in advance to remove lard have a nice texture to it. They use all ingredients that are domestically produced and carefully focus on preparing two menu items.

records.name: Soudakgye (소우닭계)
records.menu: Spicy Braised Ribs Set Meal, Wang Galbitang, Korean Beef Yukgaejang
records.description: As the name suggests, this restaurant specializes in Korean cuisine using beef and chicken. They are famous for the owner-chef’s tender ribs using the secret recipe. They make all the side dishes from scratch, and singleserving braised ribs are also available.

records.name: Yangji Chueotang (양지추어탕)
records.menu: Chueotang (Loach Soup), Fried Loach, Kodarijjim (Braised Pollack)
records.description: Yangji Chueotang uses a large traditional-style cauldron to boil their chueotang (loach soup). They use red pepper powder from the local farm and make their own kimchi, which says a lot about the food’s quality. They have many regulars thanks to the amazing flavors and generous amount of food at low prices.

records.name: Choryang Tongdak (초량통닭)
records.menu: Fried Chicken, Dakdoritang (Spicy Chicken Soup), Baeksuk (Chicken Soup)
records.description: This restaurant, which has been in business for over 40 years since 1976, is so famous that almost everybody knows about it. The juicy fried chicken here has been a favorite for a long time, and it is always full of office workers who visit after work.

records.name: Hongseongbang (홍성방)
records.menu:
Water Dumplings ￦8,000 / 10,000
Ohyangjangyuk(Five-Spice Sliced Steamed Pork) ￦30,000 / 40,000
records.description: This restaurant, which has been operated for over 50 years by three generations, is one of the most famous restaurants in Busan’s Chinatown. Water dumplings are so popular that they have long been called “Yeongju-dong water dumplings,” and there are many regulars coming from other provinces on weekends as well.

records.name: Meogeumjik (먹음직)
records.hours:
Monday–Friday: 16:00–23:00
(Last order at 22:00)
Saturday–Sunday: 12:00–23:00
(Break time 15:00–16:00)
(Last order at 22:00)
records.description: This grill restaurant located on the Oncheoncheon Cafe Street also distributes meat, so fresh meat is always ready. They also prepare meat through an aging process and are highly acclaimed for serving all dishes with integrity and sincerity.

records.name: Mimiru (미미루)
records.description: Popular for its stylish Chinese cuisine, you’ll find a wide variety of dishes that you won’t find at your average Chinese restaurant. At mealtime, there is always a queue here.

records.name: Milboss 79 (밀보스79)
records.menu: Oven-grilled Cube Steak, Crab and Shrimp Pizza, Fresh Rose Pasta
records.description: The first thing that catches your eye is the casual atmosphere. This is a dining pub where you can spend a good time at a relatively affordable price, enjoying drinks with pasta and pizza. Their pasta and sauce made from scratch go really well with beer.

records.name: Seyeonjeong (세연정)
records.menu: Special Ribs, Seasoned Ribs, 2 pcs, Grilled Ribs with Salt
records.description: A family restaurant specializing in grilled beef, Seyeonjeong is particularly known for its beef ribs. They boast a high level of hygiene and service and serve directly sourced local ingredients, homemade doenjang, and foods produced by renowned suppliers.

records.name: Jobang Nakji Madang (조방낙지마당)
records.menu: Stir-fried Octopus, Stir-fried Octopus with Shrimp, Stir-fried Octopus with Gopchang
records.description:
Most of the restaurants named “Jobang Nakji” have guaranteed quality, and this is also a guaranteed octopus restaurant. As with any business that has been in the neighborhood for a long time, it has many regular
customers, and the more affordable prices compared to other octopus restaurants will give you peace of mind.

records.name: Chorokdam Miyeokguk (초록담미역국)
records.menu: Clam Seaweed Soup, Korean Beef Seaweed Soup
records.hours:
Monday–Sunday: 10:00–20:30
(Break time 15:00–16:30)
(Last order at 19:30)

*Closed on Tuesdays
records.description: The restaurant prepares hanwoo used for seaweed soup by removing the fat and tendons and makes their own side dishes and seasonings, as well as fresh kimchi every day. They specialize in seaweed soup, the ultimate “home-cooked food,” and are known for their mild taste.

records.name: Thai Bin (타이빈)
records.menu:
Crab Pat Phong Curry ￦38,000-65,000
Punim Pat Phong Curry ￦30,000-55,000
records.description: This Thai restaurant has received the signature certification, the highest grade of Thai select, by the Thai government. They serve authentic Thai food prepared by a Thai chef. The decor of this place makes you feel like you are in Thailand.

records.name: Gyeongchalseo Yeop Chobapjip (경찰서 옆 초밥집)
records.menu: Recommended Sushi 12p, Halibut and Salmon Sushi 10p, Grilled Fish Collar
records.description: The owner-chef with 18 years of experience prepares and cooks all the ingredients. The sushi, made with guaranteed workmanship with ingredients carefully prepared for five hours every day, will not disappoint you.

records.name: Dongbaek Agassi 1961 (동백아가씨1961)
records.menu: Red Camellia Tteokbokki, White Camellia Tteokbokki, Rice Cake Skewers
records.description: This cafe-like place with a vintage interior is surprisingly famous for its instant tteokbokki. They use quality ingredients such as red pepper powder from famous regions and add various toppings from ramen to pork cutlets.

records.name: Jangeochon (장어촌)
records.menu: Grilled Freshwater Eel, Grilled Sea Eel
records.description: It is one of the best places when it comes to grilled eel in Busan. Once you experience their eel prepared immediately upon order and the special herbal sauce boiled for 6 hours, you will have no choice but to admit it.

records.name: Traditional Restaurant Wonyang (전통음식점 원양)
records.hours:
Monday–Sunday: 11:00–22:30

*Closed on 1st and 3rd Sunday of the month
records.description: It has been consistently loved by office workers for over 30 years by serving kimchi, side dishes, pickles, and sauces made with good ingredients sourced from country houses. It is especially well-reviewed by foodies. Group seating for banquets is also available.

records.name: Gugongtan
records.menu: Pork Jowl, Garlic Pork Jowl, Pork Rinds
records.description: The meat is sliced very thinly after ordering, which creates a nicer texture. Also famous for doenjang jjigae, this restaurant specializes in grilled pork jowls. If you are lucky, you may encounter a delightful event.

records.name: Geumyong Dumpling (금용만두)
records.description: This Chinese dumpling restaurant has been operating since 1960, making Shandong-style dumplings with braised pork skin and oxtail meat. It is so popular that the prepared ingredients are always sold out on the same day.

records.name: Ungcheonjip (웅천집)
records.menu: Leather Carp Hoe, Catfish Maeuntang (Spicy Soup), Grilled Eel
records.description: This is a traditional restaurant that has been in business for three generations since 1964. It is especially famous for the special sauce made with soy sauce aged for three years and leather carp hoe, but after deliberation, many guests end up trying out all the menu items, including grilled eel and maeuntang.

records.name: Pyeongyangjip (평양집)
records.menu: Dumpling Set Meal, Dumpling Hotpot, Mung Bean Pancake
records.description: This is a Pyeongyangstyle handmade dumpling restaurant that has been open for 24 years. You can discover North Korean food here, a rarity in South Korea. They make dumplings every morning to welcome the guests, and the pancakes made of 100% mung beans is also a popular menu item.

records.name: Daewang Bulmat (대왕불맛)
records.menu: Half Abomasum, Half Intestines / Spicy Abomasum / Spicy Intestines
records.hours:
Monday–Sunday: 16:00–01:00

*Closed on 2nd and 4th Monday of the month
records.description: This is a takeout and delivery restaurant specializing in offal cuisine and offers domestic gopchang and makchang cooked over direct fire. Their spicy gopchang, which eliminated the peculiar odor of intestines with homemade seasoning, is a popular item.

records.name: Jeongol[Geujip] (전골[그집])
records.menu: Spicy Brisket Hot Pot, Stir-fried Brisket with Mung Bean Sprouts, Bibim Golbaenggi (Spicy Whelk)
records.hours:
Monday–Friday: 11:00–22:00
(Break time 14:00–17:00)
(Last order at 21:00)
Sundays: 17:00–22:00
(Last order at 21:00)
records.description: After researching for over a year, the owners developed an original hotpot recipe. Now, it has people fully packed in this hard-to-find hole in the wall of a restaurant inside a small alley. Everyone will love this soup.

records.name: Hamyang Bonga Eotang Guksu (함양본가어탕국수)
records.description: Eotang guksu, noodles made with ground freshwater fish, are quite hard to find. Eotang guksu here is famous for its consistent taste without being too spicy or hard on the tongue. A lot of customers come from a far distance, too.

records.name: 50 Tan Binh (오공떵번)
records.description: While the Hanoi-style pho is perhaps the most common rice noodle in Korea, this place makes hu tieu, which are Ho Chi Minh-style. Unlike pho, the spices are not strong, which makes it enjoyable for everyone.

records.name: Uyeon Hoetjip (우연횟집)
records.menu: Assorted Hoe, Hwareo Hoe (Prepared from live fish)
records.description: This hoe restaurant is famous for long waits before opening. They prepare dishes with live fish caught immediately after ordering. They serve thick slices on a full plate at affordable prices, which makes it one of the most popular pubs in the college district.

records.name: Maparam Haemuljjim Haemultang Guseo Main Branch (마파람 해물찜 해물탕 구서본점)
records.description: The spacious hall, with stylish external and internal decor, is always full of customers. Opened in 2005, it has been a longtime local favorite for its fresh seafood and delicious marinade that anyone would enjoy.

records.name: Cheonghae Susan (청해수산)
records.menu: Assorted raw fish, Seasonal live fish (market price)
records.description: Famous for its thick slices of raw fish, it looks like an ordinary market hoetjip, but it is so popular that the queue starts early and remains long until late hours, even on weekdays. The thickness of raw fish can be accommodated. A lot of customers also frequent the place for takeouts.

records.name: Gungjung Haemultang Jossijip (궁중해물탕 조씨집)
records.description: Opened in 1959, it is a famous seafood soup restaurant that has operated for two generations. The 100-year seafood soup with plenty of fish entrails and seafood is the main dish. It is receiving positive responses by developing original items without depending solely on long-standing traditional dishes.

records.name: Kkachi Hoetjip (까치횟집)
records.description:
There are many good raw fish (Korean sashimi) restaurants in Gwangalli where you can dine
against the backdrop of the wonderful sea view. Kkachi Hoetjip is one such place.
The white kimchi prepared from scratch goes well with raw fish, and the crabs and shrimp marinated in soy sauce are refreshingly tasty.

records.name: Micheong Sikdang (미청식당)
records.hours:
Monday–Friday: 10:00–20:00
(Break time 15:00–17:00)
(Last order at 19:40)
Saturday–Sunday: 10:00–20:00
(Last order at 19:40)
records.description: Located at Ilgwang Beach, Micheong specializes in bibimbap using common sea urchins, locally called “anjanggu.” Having a few items on the menu adds to the restaurant’s credibility. The waitlist is considerably long.

records.name: P. Ark Cafe & Bakery (피아크 카페 & 베이커리)
records.menu:
Mild blue dolce latte ￦8,500
P.ARK mont blanc ￦7,500
records.description: This huge bakery cafe boasts its harbor view. During weekends, crowds gather here like an amusement park, but the wait is short thanks to the spacious hall. It serves over 80 different pastries, drinks, and ice cream and has various things to see.

records.name: QG (큐제)
records.hours:
Monday–Friday: 08:30–22:00
(Last order at 21:30)
Saturday–Sunday: 11:00–21:00
(Last order at 20:30)
records.description:
QG is a small bakery cafe run by a French patisserie. It uses the finest wheat and butter to bake bread using natural sourdough starters and low-temperature fermentation. The cafe offers over 20 different kinds of bread, including baguettes and croissants, the best-known bakeries from France.

*Weekend operations are limited to café until further notice

records.name: Coffee Sugamo in Seomyeon (커피스가모 인 서면)
records.description: This is a rare place that uses traditional hand-drip and syphon methods for brewing coffee. It takes a little longer, but the distinct flavors are worth it. The cafe has a very refined style and adheres to old ways of operation, such as taking orders after the customers are seated and receiving payment at the end of service.

records.name: Chiramsagye (칠암사계)
records.description: This place attracts so many people that the huge hall feels small. At this famous cafe, customers can enjoy a variety of bread and drinks as they view the sea of Gijang. All the places are pretty, all the bread is delicious, and salt bread and Chiramdol Manju are especially famous.

records.name: Choryang Ondang (초량온당)
records.description: At this famous bakery, a long queue is formed to buy the bread around the opening hour. You can find a variety of combinations and recipes that are rare even in Busan, the city of bread. The most popular items are bread made with yellow cheese

records.name: Wonjo Badajip (원조 바다집)
records.menu:
Sujung jeongol(Seafood hot pot) ￦12,000
Nakjibokkeum(Stir-fried small octopus) ￦11,000
records.description: The famous restaurant, which has been in business for more than 50 years, has also been introduced on several TV shows. Sujung jeongol, full of seafood ingredients, is the dish that made the place famous. It also evokes nostalgia to the locals.

records.name: Lee Heung-yong Bakery PNU Branch (이흥용과자점 부산대직영점)
records.description: Owned by one of the most famous Korean confectionery masters, it uses quality ingredients such as sun-dried salt from Sinan that removed salt water for four years and seasonal domestic produce. Over 100 kinds of bread and desserts are prepared and served every day.

records.name: Somunnan Wonjo Jobangnakji (소문난 원조 조방낙지)
records.description: This restaurant has been in business for three generations since 1972 and is one of the best-known places in Busan. It is always filled with customers who enjoy bone broth made from scratch and secret marinade.

records.name: Odaeyang Hoetjip (오대양횟집)
records.description: It looks like any other hoetjip that specializes in raw fish (Korean sashimi), but it unusually also offers pork and beef barbecue. Though it may seem unusual to eat meat at a raw fish place, most begin with meat and finish with raw fish. It is also a popular place for delivery.

records.name: Oryukdo Nakji Beomil Main Branch (오륙도 낙지 범일본점)
records.menu: Nakgopsae bokkeum (small octopus, pork intestines, and shrimp stir-fry),  Octopus and other seafood soup
records.description: Since 1996, it has been operating for more than 30 years and has been introduced through various TV programs. Because of their fame, other places started using similar names, so they decided to register their patent and trademark. It was also designated as the first traditional Busan restaurant in Dong-gu.

records.name: Ilmi Agujjim (일미아구찜)
records.description: Located in Ilgwang Beach, this is an agujjim (braised monkfish) specialty restaurant. They use extra-large monkfish for the braise and allow customers to choose the level of spiciness at the time of order. It is very famous and filled with guests all the time.

records.name: Jeju Bokguk (제주복국)
records.menu:
Striped puffer soup(spicy or mild) ￦20,000
Tiger puffer soup(spicy or mild) ￦22,000
records.description: Unlike most bokguk (pufferfish soup) places that serve in earthen pots, this restaurant divides the soup on the spot by the number of people and serves them directly in the bowl. It is one of the best bokguk spots in Busan that always makes the list. The spacious hall is notable for its classic atmosphere.

records.name: 1966 Jungwon (1966정원)
records.hours:
Monday–Sunday: 10:00–19:00
(Last order at 18:00)
Saturday–Sunday: 09:00–21:00
(Last order at 20:00)
records.description: Located in a quiet fishing village, this western restaurant stands out with a small garden and an antique-style interior. Its main item is the handmade burger, made with buns baked by the owner. The menu also offers pilaf, salad, and various beverages.

records.name: Yongho Halmae Patbingsu Danpatjuk (용호할매팥빙수단팥죽)
records.menu: Patbingsu (shaved ice with red beans), Danpatjuk (sweet red bean porridge)
records.description: The shaved ice with red beans and red bean porridge have been longtime local favorites at this 40-year business continued by second-generation owners. It uses locally sourced ingredients such as whole red beans boiled from scratch, Miryang ice valley apples, and Busan milk to maintain the unchanging flavors.

records.name: Old Mug
records.description: Old Mug is a hand-drip specialty cafe with the beach train running in the back and connected to a walking trail. Many guests come here to see the sunrise and have tea time in the early morning. Both indoor and outdoor areas are cozy, great for enjoying a different side of Songjeong Beach.

records.name: A’de Choi (아데초이)
records.description: The intense colors and quaint decor of the interior look nice against the sea view outside the window. The desserts, famous for their refined flavors, are made by the owner who trained at Tokyo Confectionery School. It plays classical and jazz music appreciated by the older clientele of the place.

records.name: Villa Villekulla (빌라 빌레쿨라)
records.description: Named after the hut where Pippi Longstocking lived, Villa Villekulla is a relaxing spot in the city center. Desserts and drinks, including handmade pancakes, are made of good ingredients. Every corner of the cafe gives off a warm atmosphere.

records.name: Brittany (브리타니)
records.description:
Located in a quiet coastal village, Brittany is a cozy cafe with a large window that shows
the beautiful view of Gadeok-do coast.
It also has a rooftop terrace and a simple dining menu.

records.name: Break in Coffee (브레이크인 커피)
records.description: Take a break from your daily routine and enjoy a cup of coffee here in the panoramic forest. It’s a cafe but also a bakery of a Korean confectionery master of 22 years. Customers’ favorites include watermelon bread and tiger bread with interesting shapes.

records.name: bread365
records.description: Bread 365 makes bread for easy digestion using natural sourdough starters and low-temperature fermentation. All the bread is displayed in the showcase to keep hands off, and baguette sandwiches freshly made every day are the most popular.

records.name: Borison Patisserie Main Branch (보리종파티세리 본점)
records.menu: Salt bread, Sweet pumpkin fig basket
records.description: In pursuit of making delicious and healthy bread, this bakery is popular for its buttery and chewy salt bread. The best-known items are various European bread made of natural sourdough starters and healthy whole-wheat bread.

records.name: Baunova (바우노바)
records.description: Baunova Cafe uses a variety of coffee beans and changes them 3-4 times a day. Baristas with water sommelier and SCA coffee certifications brew the right coffee for each customer. It has many regulars, including foreigners

records.name: Phomantico PNU Branch (부산대 포맨티코)
records.menu:
A set(2 persons) ￦35,000
B set(2 persons) ￦39,000
records.description: To make proper broth, this restaurant boils beef leg bones for over 24 hours and carefully prepares the ingredients every morning. No matter which cuisine it is, dedication is what makes great food. It’s highly recommended to people who have been unfamiliar with Vietnamese food.

records.name: Myeongnan Brand Laboratory (명란브랜드연구소)
records.hours:
Tuesday–Saturday: 10:00–21:00
(Last order at 20:00)
Sundays: 10:00–19:00
(Last order at 18:00)
records.description: Located on Choryang Ibagu-gil in Dong-gu, this five-story building is filled with everything about myeongnan (pollack roe). The third and fourth floors are operated as a cafe that serves food made of myeongnan. Note: only drinks are sold on weekends.

records.name: Yukhwamok (육화목)
records.description: The owner of more than 10 years of experience prepares and serves meat at the time of order. Both Hanwoo beef and Handon pork are available. It’s a coal barbecue restaurant recommended for special occasions.

records.name: A bamboo (어밤부)
records.menu: Pad Thai, Bu Pad Pong Karee
